name: Yale Golf Course
location: New Haven (Upper Westville), New Haven County, Connecticut
architects: Seth Raynor with Charles Blair Macdonald (consultant) and Charles Banks (construction), opened 1926; Roger Rulewich (1990s); restored by Gil Hanse and Jim Wagner, reopened 28 April 2026

dtm.source: Connecticut 2023 statewide lidar bare-earth DEM (CT ECO ImageServer elevation/Statewide2023, 2 ft source pixels, flown spring 2023, QL1), exported at 1 m in WGS 84 / UTM 18N (EPSG:32618), NAVD88 feet; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-yale, yale_ct2023_dem.tif)

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (way 43437312, 943 x 1,478 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,280 m east-west (168 m each side), 1,792 m north-south (157 m each side)

scorecard_source: The course's post-restoration card (2026): the developer's screenshot of the 'Yale Golf Course Yardage' page (release yale-data, Screenshot.2026-10-24.140812.png), per hole for Championship, Long, Regular and Short with par and stroke index; every row adds up to its printed total. Matches GolfPass's per-hole card and 18Birdies' ratings and stroke index (docs/scouting/yale on branch scouting/new-courses). Men's ratings: Championship 74.7/144, Long 71.5/139, Regular 68.9/130, Short 64.5/110. Built from Championship (the tips) and Long (next forward; there is no Blue), Long the default (developer, 2026-10-30).
attribution: Elevation: Connecticut 2023 statewide lidar (CT ECO, UConn / CT DEEP)
Trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (CT_2023Statewide_C25 lidar)
Imagery checked: CT ECO 2023 orthophotos, USDA NAIP
notes: Overnight build (developer away, 2026-10-30/31): standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1) except the tee sets (developer: the back tees plus the set one step forward when there is no Blue). Every penalty area red; OSM boundary is OB; range OB; trees from lidar with trees on fairways removed (trees_off_fairways_m 2); wind 1-9 mph (inland New England, wooded, about 5 km from Long Island Sound). New theme yale (approved by the scouting kickoff). All data predate the 2023-26 Hanse restoration.
